style: Clean, confident, minimal tech/product intro. Dark charcoal ground, single bold sans-serif hero wordmark, restrained accent color used only for emphasis words and the final lockup underline. No noise, no texture — the motion of the type itself is the whole show.

customize.note: Reuse caption-kinetic-slam for the scene-1 wordmark slam and scene-4 lockup; hand-author scene 2/3 as a simple type-on + wipe using hyperframes-animation kinetic-type rules (no asset dependency).

scenes.motion: hard slam-in on the wordmark (scale 1.15→1.0 + slight overshoot), emphasis word flashes the accent color for one frame then settles to white

scenes.text: A domain reserved for illustrative examples.
scenes.motion: line types on left-to-right with a soft mask wipe (pattern-interrupt from the slam); emphasis words underline-draw in accent color as they land
text slides up from baseline with a trailing arrow that draws in and nudges rightward on a loop-out, cueing exit
wordmark reassembles at reduced scale into a centered lockup, accent-color underline draws left-to-right beneath it and holds to black
